title: Weave
tagline: Weave, a "Meet-to-Earn" SocialFi project, boosts event visibility by integrating an interactive map and by rewarding the attendees for their participation.
description:
Event organizers contribute to the community by allocating 2% of the event price paid for listing in GHO or AAVE GHO's collaterals to participants physically present, determined by their GPS coordinates, allowing them to exchange points for GHO tokens.

This concept not only addresses the need for effective event promotion but also aims to replace traditional event tokens like POAP with a more tangible and valuable reward system.

Additionally, by incorporating location-based rewards, you're fostering real-world networking opportunities, making the overall event experience more engaging and rewarding for attendees.

To prevent GPS spoofing, users would need to be physically present at the event and verify by the event organizers for them to then claim their points on the map.

Including a competitive ranking ladder enhances the experience even further.
how_its_made:
The Weave project has been built using NextJS 14 and Typescript for the Front-End.

Our interactive map functionality is enriched by the integration of Leaflet & React Leaflet, allowing users to effortlessly explore and navigate and claim their rewards directly on it.

To create a event USDC / GHO / ETH and others token from the Sepolia AAVE Collaterals can be used as payment token.

Smart contract interaction is facilitated by Wagmi, securely connecting the front end with the blockchain. 

Simplifying the user wallet connection process we're using ConnectKit.

Tailwind CSS / RadixUI & miui for the Design and components.

SIWE to secure access to users messages API and store on SupabaseDB.

And real-time user location markers through Supabase Realtime.
